title: memnc throughput config
description: Optional config for the inference_status throughput verdict (Frank-Formel). Lives OUTSIDE the repo (default ~/.config/memnc/throughput.json, path overridable via MEMNC_THROUGHPUT_CONFIG) because it describes specific hardware. All keys are case-insensitive substrings matched against lspci product names / GGUF filenames.

gpu_bandwidth.description: Effective decode bandwidth in GB/s, keyed by a substring of the lspci product name (case-insensitive).

quant_bits.description: Average bits per weight for each quantization tag found in GGUF filenames (case-insensitive substring, longest tag wins).
